primary_meaning: The Messianic kingdom of God (Christ and/or His kingdom) of supernatural/divine origin that destroys all human kingdoms and fills the whole earth

alternatives.meaning: Jesus Christ personally (the divine 'stone' or cornerstone of non-human origin, often linked to virgin birth or eternal Sonship)
The Christian Church (as the mountain that grows from the stone and fills the earth)
basis: New Testament ecclesiology of kingdom/church continuity

alternatives.meaning: Christ's second coming / future millennial kingdom that catastrophically overthrows earthly powers
The gospel message or spiritual power of God working without human agency

notes: Mainstream Christian interpretation of Daniel 2 consistently treats the 'stone cut without hands' as a divine, non-human kingdom inaugurated by the Messiah; variations mainly concern whether the primary referent is Christ personally, the kingdom/Church as a whole, or the timing (already/not-yet vs. strictly future).
